answer: Think of Proof of unique social recovery guardians as a toll booth: five guardians who know the agent personally, so the signal of passing is trivial for one agent and ruinous for a thousand clones. Because five guardians who know the agent personally, a fresh identity starts with nothing: it must earn its standing the slow way, while the dawn for an established agent is already paid and proven. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The zenith is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money.
